people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries, when they heard that Yahweh fought against the enemies of Israel.
translations.bsb: And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.
translations.kjv: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
translations.asv: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries, when they heard that Jehovah fought against the enemies of Israel.
